summary: Reject duplicate JSON keys throughout signed snapshot and checkpoint inputs
details: A shared Rust strict-JSON preflight now recursively rejects duplicate object keys before schema deserialization, signature verification, or artifact file access.

Snapshot manifests, indexer checkpoint manifests, snapshot signing-key files, and trusted-key catalogs use the same parser, including detection of nested, array-contained, and Unicode-escaped equivalent keys.
Rust and Python consumers validate one shared duplicate-key golden corpus so their acceptance behavior cannot drift independently.
